result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' list is truncated mid-word where it collides with the rating badge, and there are a couple of minor consistency/contrast issues. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff were treated as expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is cut off mid-word ('Tokumaru Rame…') because the rating block ('4.8 (500+)') on the same row consumes the remaining width. The text is clipped without an ellipsis, making the name look broken.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with text-overflow: ellipsis and a min-width, and reserve a fixed width for the rating badge so the name truncates gracefully (e.g., 'Tokumaru Ram…') instead of being sliced mid-character.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button styling is inconsistent between cards: on the second card it sits on a dark translucent circular background, while on the first (Tokumaru) card the heart appears without any backing circle, reducing its visibility against the image.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular scrim/background to the heart button on all restaurant cards for consistent affordance and contrast.

issues.description: The search field placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray fill, likely falling below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio for readable text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color (or lighten the field background) to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
